name: Mockza Production Langfuse Observability & Alerting Rules

alerts.name: PII / Student Contact Leakage in Evaluation Graph
alerts.description: Triggered when an evaluation prompt or completion contains unmasked email, phone number, or government ID.

alerts.name: Evaluation Graph P95 Latency Spike
alerts.description: Triggered when LangGraph multi-step evaluation P95 latency exceeds 4,000ms.

alerts.name: Rubric Score Out of Bounds / NaN
alerts.condition: value < 0.0 OR value > 9.0 OR value IS NULL
alerts.description: Triggered when an LLM evaluation returns an invalid score outside the canonical 0.0..9.0 IELTS band scale.

alerts.name: High Rate of Primary Model Fallback
alerts.description: Triggered when primary DeepSeek/Gemini model errors exceed 5% and trigger backup provider fallbacks.
